study: Babinski et al. 2018 — Developing Consultation & Collaboration Skills (DCCS) teacher PD, cluster RCT, K-2 English learners
delivery_evidence: DCCS delivered in person: a five-day summer institute plus four follow-up content/application modules, on-site instructional coaching ~every six weeks from research-team members, and weekly 30-min in-school ESL-classroom teacher collaboration across the year (PD components, p.~123-125; Figure 1).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is the Woodcock Munoz Language Survey-Revised (WMLS-R), a published norm-referenced standardized language/literacy battery independently developed (Schrank et al.), not tailored to the intervention (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table 5).
curriculum_evidence: PD aims to increase teachers' use of high-impact instructional strategies for language/literacy, ESL-classroom collaboration, and incorporation of students' cultural wealth using existing instruction; no new curriculum/materials package adopted (PD description, p.~120-123).
outcome_timing_evidence: WMLS-R posttest administered at the end of the school year, immediately after the one-year PD (extraction timepoint=post, end of school year); no delayed follow-up wave.
